title: Opus 5.5 Generated pixel intro
author: Environmental-Wear13
selftext:
I saw another post about generating pixel cinematics, which I thought was pretty cool. I started to play with it trying to setup an intro cinematic to my rpg game. Still work in progress but I thought it was pretty powerful!

This costed me about 46% of my 5 hour limit on a 20$ plan. One prompt for each scene, with some tweaks as well (and some more tweaks needed)

  
Music: "Death Is Just Another Path" by Otto Halmén (CC-BY 3.0) – [https://opengameart.org/content/death-is-just-another-path](https://opengameart.org/content/death-is-just-another-path)

Absolutely, when I get back home later I'll send an update here with the initial prompt! 

I basically had one giant prompt for the first scene, then the follow up scenes I simply described what the scenes should be and it kept the style throughout the set of scenes pretty well.

replies.author: Environmental-Wear13
replies.body:
Create a 9-second opening cinematic shot for my dark fantasy game "Shadows of Imalor", as a self-contained HTML canvas animation. Draw everything procedurally in pixel art at 320x180, with no image assets, and scale it up with crisp nearest-neighbor pixels, no anti-aliasing. Use a widescreen letterbox with black bars.

The narration line is: "In the first age, the divine walked among mortals."

Scene: a ruined stone courtyard at night. Broken, cracked columns frame both sides, there are crumbling wall fragments, and a small distant city and mountain silhouettes sit under a dithered navy sky. Three human-sized divines stand among seven ordinary mortals. The divines wear broad layered hoods with no visible faces (just black shadow inside), short split blue-gray robes with bronze trim, and each holds a tall golden staff. The mortals wear plain earth-toned work shirts, belts, trousers and boots, with visible faces and hair. One of them is a child, and a few bow their heads.

Action: fade in from black. Gold light slowly climbs the staff of the divine on the right, then a celestial sigil unfolds above it: fine etched gold rings, orbiting angular runes, floating stone fragments and a small diamond core. A subtle gold ripple spreads along the ground around him. Robes sway slightly and dust drifts through the air. The camera does a slow, smooth push-in, drifting slightly right, with no stepping or wobble. Fade to black at the end.

Palette: cold and muted (deep navy, teal, slate, blue-black) with gold as the only warm accent. The mood is quiet and reverent, like a half-remembered legend.
